ValidationRule.description: Only allows users to change DQ Reasons to Account Not Qualified, Competitor, Country, No Response, Payer, Account Too Small, or Trash. 1/10/2024 – updated with Bad Email Address SAL-3511
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'B - Marketo Integration', $User.User_LongID__c <> '005f2000009yztxAAA', $User.User_LongID__c <> '0058W00000AFZm6QAH', NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Disqualified_Reason__c), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Disqualified_Reason__c))), TEXT(Disqualified_Reason__c)<>"Account Not Qualified", TEXT(Disqualified_Reason__c)<>"Bad Email Address", TEXT(Disqualified_Reason__c)<>"Competitor", TEXT(Disqualified_Reason__c)<>"Country", TEXT(Disqualified_Reason__c)<>"No Response", TEXT(Disqualified_Reason__c)<>"Too Small", TEXT(Disqualified_Reason__c)<>"Trash", TEXT(Disqualified_Reason__c)<>"Payer" ) && Contact_Automation_Bypassed__c = False
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can only update the Disqualification Reason to Account Not Qualified, Account Too Small, Bad Email Address, Competitor, Country, No Response, Trash, or Payer.
